ABOUT SUKHDA HEALTHCARE

Over Two Decades of Excellence,
Compassion & Quality Care

Sukhda Multispeciality Hospital is the brainchild of Dr. Amit Mehta, MD Medicine (AIIMS, New Delhi). After extensive clinical experience at AIIMS New Delhi, PGIMER Chandigarh, and heading Critical Care at Jindal Hospital for 9 years, Dr. Mehta established Sukhda in November 2002 with the mission of "Care and Cure for Whole Family Under One Roof".

Today, under the administrative and quality leadership of Dr. Manisha Mehta (NABH Certified Assessor), Sukhda has expanded into a 100-bedded NABH-accredited network with Sukhda Multispeciality Hospital and Sukhda MedPark (Cancer & Super Speciality Hospital), delivering top-tier healthcare at affordable cost across Haryana, Punjab, and Rajasthan.
